description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of it due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Improvised Arsenal tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Crime Novelist triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Kaya, Geist Hunter
uses.cardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
